```plato

// A single cubic Hermite segment in space: interpolates Start to End with the
// given outgoing and incoming tangents
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cubic_Hermite_spline).
type HermiteCurve3D
    implements ICurve3D
{
    Start: Point3D;
    StartTangent: Vector3D;
    End: Point3D;
    EndTangent: Vector3D;
}
```
